verdict.rationale: The docs show skills living at a project-relative `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` path, which supports a project-local, repo-committable scope. The only cross-project signal is that plugins are described as 'reusable across projects', with no explicit user-global skill directory or install-scope choice documented. The keyless install into ./.claude/skills/ used third-party `npx skills` tooling, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented user-global skill location (home-directory scope), an explicit scope selector at install time (e.g. for `/plugin install`), and documentation that project skills are meant to be committed and shared via the repo.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects

citations.quote: a skill at `.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md` both create `/deploy` and work the same way
Sharing with teammates, distributing to community, versioned releases, reusable across projects
